note: Questions with a checkable answer marker. Each `must_contain` entry is a case-insensitive regex; a match means the answer is present in the text being examined. Questions are narrow and factual so the marker is unambiguous — this set measures whether compression discards the answer, not whether the web is correct. The `acronym` category deliberately over-samples the failure mode found in the first run, so it can be confirmed or dismissed rather than guessed at.
